## Topics
- Histograms, density plots, boxplots, scatterplots
- Bar charts and segmented bars
- Demographic (age-sex) pyramids
- Principles of effective visualization
- Ethics: misrepresentation with graphs

## Learning objectives
By the end of this module you should be able to:

- Choose an appropriate plot for one or two variables
- Build an age-sex pyramid
- Improve a plot's readability (scales, themes, labels)
- Recognize misleading axes and cherry-picked comparisons

## Data
NHANES; published public health charts (critique examples)

## Further reading: The Epidemiologist R Handbook
- [Demographic pyramids](https://epirhandbook.com/en/new_pages/age_pyramid.html)
